title: UK CPI, January 2027 (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET) — the annual weights print, and the single date on which the electricity-VAT step stops being a range
source: EST: ons.gov.uk/releases/consumerpriceinflationukjanuary2027, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the ONS release page reads 'Consumer price inflation, UK: January 2027', '17 February 2027 7:00am', is labelled 'Provisional', and states 'This release is not yet published'. Filed estimate on ONS's own Provisional label, on this lane's no-self-confirm limit, and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA:) has no slot for the UK Office for National Statistics. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of uk-cpi-2027-05-19, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-cpi-2027-05-19 LANE, 2026-09-09. This is the JANUARY print, which is the one ONS release each year that publishes the NEW ANNUAL CPI WEIGHTS -- and that is the only reason it is being diarised. It is a kill switch for two ledgers at once. The SI 2026/987 electricity VAT step is sized as weight x 4.7619%, and the 2027 electricity weight is undrawn until this print: ONS series CJXA, fetched 2026-09-09, reads 17.0 (2019), 18.0 (2020), 19.0 (2021), 20.0 (2022), 27.0 (2023), 23.3142 (2024), 19.1488 (2025), 20.6065 (2026) per 1000, which maps the step to 0.081-0.129pp rather than to any single number. Until 2027-02-17 both uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01 and uk-cpi-2027-05-19 carry a RANGE; after it they carry a number. TWO DISTINCT THINGS RESOLVE HERE AND THEY ARE EASY TO CONFLATE: (1) the WEIGHT VINTAGE -- where the 2027 draw lands inside or outside that history, which is what widens or narrows the band; and (2) whether ONS applies a SPECIAL ADJUSTMENT for the VAT distortion. The parent lane's Leg 1 established that the reversion's tax arithmetic (+5/100 = 5.0%) is 5% larger than the cut's (-5/105 = 4.7619%) and is offset EXACTLY because ONS price-updates the 2027 weight to December 2026 and January 2027, both INSIDE the zero-rate window, so the weight itself comes in at about 1/1.05 of its counterfactual and (1/1.05) x (5/100) = 5/105. That cancellation is an inference from published methodology, not an ONS statement about this case; a special adjustment breaks it and makes the reversion step about 5% larger than the cut's. This print is where that is observable. A NARROWER CORRECTION THE PROPOSING LANE RECORDS: the parent's kill switch is worded as the electricity weight landing 'outside 19-27 per 1000', a band drawn from four years when eight are published -- 17.0 (2019) and 18.0 (2020) both sit outside it, so that switch would fire on a value this series has actually printed twice. Caveat, stated: pre-2023 weights publish to whole numbers, so the low floor is partly a precision artifact. Tiered LOW on the same measurement as its siblings: symbols: [], no UK listing, gilt or sterling instrument on this calendar, and the whole tracked universe is eight US mega-caps. NOTE FOR WHOEVER RESEARCHES THIS: the January print is ALSO the venue for the last full drag-in month before the lapse quarter closes, and it is the second of the six zero-rated months (Oct-2026 to Mar-2027) -- but its diarised value is the weights, not the level. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
